results.title: Updated INDIGO Results Demonstrate Sustained PFS Benefit With Vorasidenib in IDH-Mutant Glioma
results.description: Timothy Cloughesy, MD, discusses updated long-term findings from the phase 3 INDIGO trial evaluating vorasidenib in IDH-mutant glioma, highlighting sustained progression-free survival benefit, delayed subsequent intervention, and differences in treatment outcomes between astrocytoma and oligodendroglioma subgroups.
